it.txt: Presidente da Câmara Municipal, tomou posse como prefeito interino em 27/08/2026, depois que a Justiça Eleitoral afastou o prefeito Calé Vidal e o vice Joás Ferraz Michetti, que tiveram os mandatos cassados. Na eleição suplementar de 25/10/2026, foram eleitos Zé Izac (PT), prefeito, e Joaquim do Venerando (PT), vice; eles tomam posse depois da diplomação pela Justiça Eleitoral.
it.txt_en: As president of the City Council, he was sworn in as acting mayor on August 27, 2026, after the Electoral Courts removed Mayor Calé Vidal and Vice Mayor Joás Ferraz Michetti, whose terms were revoked. In the special election held on October 25, 2026, Zé Izac (PT) was elected mayor and Joaquim do Venerando (PT) vice mayor; they take office after being certified by the Electoral Courts.
